excludedAssessments.summary: The decoding, cardinality, coordinate bounds, verifier logic, grid embedding, and row-count upper bound are sound. However, the record provides no independently checkable execution attestation, determinant table, or equivalent exhaustive calculation showing that all 573,800 determinants for the supplied certificate are nonzero. Thus D(77) <= 154 is established, but the computational obligation needed for D(77) >= 152—and hence the combined interval 152 <= D(77) <= 154—remains unresolved.

The horizontal-row argument unconditionally establishes D(77) <= 154.
A hypothetical 154-point configuration must contain exactly two points in every row and every column.
The database links are provenance-only and are not mathematically required because the certificate is reproduced locally.

However, the declared package is not fully established: its exhaustive rotational classification omits rotations of orders other than two and four, and its exact constraint counts, certificate-check results, and bounded solver-run history lack trusted execution evidence.

The elementary counts of 1444 off-diagonal orbit variables, 38 diagonal-pair variables, and 154 selected points are analytically supported.
The contribution supplies neither a 154-point certificate nor an infeasibility proof and therefore does not change the stated interval 152 <= D(77) <= 154.
Even if the bounded searches occurred as reported, their UNKNOWN/timeout outcomes would provide no evidence of nonexistence.
The rotation lemma correctly excludes half-turn symmetry at size 153, quarter-turn symmetry at sizes 153 and 154, and locates any half-turn center for a 154-point set at (38,38).
